title: The optimal stationary diagonal squeeze beats the vacuum coefficient at every positive coupling

profiled_upper.reduced_functional: After optimizing the constant mean on the active branch, J_g(A)=F_*(A)+6gA(2c_C-A), 0<A<=c_C. For A>=c_C, K1524's optimized interaction is at least 6g c_C^2 and the free cost is nonnegative, so no high-variance profile beats the vacuum.
profiled_upper.self_consistency: The unique interior minimizer is parametrized by the unique kappa_g>0 satisfying R(kappa_g)=24g, equivalently kappa_g=24g[c_C-A(kappa_g)].
profiled_upper.all_coupling_strictness: Because R rises strictly from 0 to infinity, kappa_g exists for every g>0. Since J_g'(A)=D(kappa)[24g-R(kappa)]/2, it is the unique global minimum and J_g(A(kappa_g))<J_g(c_C)=6g c_C^2.
profiled_upper.origin_mechanism: The positive solution at arbitrarily small g is enabled by D(kappa)/kappa tending to infinity at the three-dimensional cube origin; the effect is nonperturbatively small as g tends to zero but is strictly nonzero.
profiled_upper.finite_cutoff_recovery: Set s_(N,k)=omega_k/sqrt(omega_k^2+kappa_g N^2), use equal real sine/cosine factors, and choose y_N=[3(C_N-V_N)-m^2/(4g)]_+. Riemann sums give V_N/N^2->A(kappa_g), N^(-4)q0->F[s_(kappa_g)] and the optimized interaction coefficient ->6gA(kappa_g)[2c_C-A(kappa_g)].
profiled_upper.unrestricted_limsup: Therefore limsup_(N to infinity)E_N/N^4<=h_g^prof:=J_g(A(kappa_g))<6g c_C^2 for every fixed g>0.
profiled_upper.uniform_family_comparison: The profiled family strictly improves the best K1562 uniform-squeeze coefficient for every g>0: it beats the vacuum below K1562's threshold and strictly lowers the free cost at the same variance for every nonvacuum uniform optimizer above it.
profiled_upper.scope_guard: This is a stronger explicit Gaussian upper coefficient, not a matching unrestricted lower coefficient, ratio convergence, a full-theory phase transition, localization, compactness, Mosco recovery or bounded-error recentering.
